verses.1: And Maryam and Aaron spoke to Moses about the situation of the woman who was being punished for having taken another man’s wife.
verses.2: And they said, “But only in Moses’ words does the Lord speak. But also in us, the Lord hears.”
verses.3: And Moses was the most humble of all people, compared to every other person on earth.
verses.4: And the LORD said suddenly to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “Go out of your places and go to the tent of meeting.” And they went out together.
verses.5: And Jehovah descended in the form of a cloud. He stood at the entrance of the tabernacle. He called out for Aaron and Miriam. And they both came out.
verses.6: And he said, “Listen to my words. If your Lord becomes a prophet before you, then I will know through dreams what he will say.”
verses.7: My servant Moses was not true in every house I went to.
verses.8: I will speak of it, and I will show you what it means. It’s not something that can be explained or understood through words. The Lord will see and understand it. Do not be afraid to speak of these things to my servants, in the name of Moses.
verses.9: And Jehovah struck them, and they went away.
verses.10: And the cloud disappeared from above the tabernacle. Then, Miriam was covered with snow. Aaron went to see Miriam, and there she was, covered with snow.
verses.11: And Aaron said to Moses, “Please forgive us for our sins and the sins we have committed.”
verses.12: Please don’t be like a dead person who, upon leaving the womb of his mother, ate half of his flesh.
verses.13: And Moses cried out to Jehovah, saying, “Please heal her!”
verses.14: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “They shall not eat anything for seven days. They must keep it sealed for seven days outside the camp. After that, they may eat it again.”
verses.15: And Mary was confined outside the camp for seven days. The people did not go to join Mary.
verses.16: And after that, the people left their homes and stopped at the shore of the Gulf of Paran.
